messages:
Alex W: FYI perf-lab repro for the new kernel set shows a p99 regression on seqlen=1024 for AVX512 nodes. Not huge but consistent: ~3.2% increase in token latency vs baseline.
Maria G: ugh. Is this the arch-aware pick change from the last rollout?
Alex W: yep — autotuner started preferring the vectorized path (v2) for 1024 because avg throughput was slightly better in microbench. But real traces with KV warmups reveal worse tail.
Jamal T: do we have a golden trace to repro? I can run the harness locally.
Alex W: I attached the minimal repro command we used in perf-lab: ```./bench_runner --model t5-xxl --kernel-set v2 --seqlen 1024 --kv-warmup 3 --batch-policy continuous --iters 5000``` Output snippet: ```median=9.7ms p95=18.3ms p99=27.1ms``` Baseline (v1): ```median=9.5ms p95=17.4ms p99=26.2ms```
CI Bot: lab-compare job 4876 finished. Artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/artifacts/4876/ (microbench, perf traces, flamegraphs). Regression flagged: p99 +3.2% (threshold 2.0%).
Chen L: can you paste the flamegraph link? I want to check KV cache churn and memcpy hotspots.
Alex W: flamegraph: https://perf.redwood/s/4876/flame.html — top of stack shows memcpy in kv-serialize + small mutex waits on cache entry creation. Seems v2 does more aggressive kv copying for prefix reuse.
Maria G: interesting — autotuner's cost model omits the lock contention penalty when kv entries are created frequently. That explains worse tail even if avg improves.
Sarah P: any quick mitigation? Canary fallback?
Alex W: for now we bumped the gating threshold in the runtime to prefer v1 when seqlen >= 768 and kv-warmup rate is > 1/s; it's a short-term guard. We should improve the autotuner model.
Jamal T: I'll add a microprobe that stresses kv warmup / prefix sharing and run a nightly sweep across all arch variants. Proposed probe: ```for q in 1 2 4; do ./microprobe --seq 1024 --kv-warmup $q --conns 8 --kernel v2; done```
Chen L: add a metric for mutex hold time and copy bytes in the probe. If we can surface that to the tuner, it can penalize kv-heavy paths.
Maria G: agree. Also run the probe on avx2 and avx512; the autotuner currently learned on avx2-heavy microbench corpus.
CI Bot: scheduled nightly job perf-scan-4876 across avx2,avx512,a100. Runs start 1719080000.
Alex W: next steps I propose: 1) Jamal adds the probe and mutextime metric; 2) Chen extends autotuner feature set to include kv-copy-cost; 3) Short-term runtime gate applied (done); 4) triage results tomorrow.
Sarah P: sounds good. Please drop perf links here after the nightly run. :thumbsup:
Alex W: will do. Thanks all.
